scripts.ios:sync: vite build --mode ios && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && cap run ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
